notes.content: Added Auto-Aim option on options menu in the middle of gameplay, it was allways enabled, now you can disable it to enjoy the most exigent gameplay experience and inprove optimization

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content: Optimization

notes.title: Fixes and improvements
notes.content: [p]-Graphic Engine Updated from unity 2022 to Unity 6.2 [/p][p]-Performance and optimization increased [/p][p]-Graphic Changes [/p][p]-Shaders and lighting modified for Stages [/p][p]-Improved shader model compatibility [/p][p]-Fixed issues with empty names on online mode and much more problems there [/p][p]-Now any changed settings of control options will take effect on online mode [/p][p]-Now all the control settings works for any control scheme chosen[/p][p]-Added more rocks on the first stage to prevent users to get lost and improving the first stage design [/p][p]-Lot of fixes for online mode that caused unplayable behaviors [/p][p]-The lighting for Vasaltis and for enemies have been improved [/p][p]-NavMesh updated [/p][p]-More minor fixes[/p][p]-Moved a rock that traped an streamer inside[/p]

notes.title: Remastered Cinematics & More
notes.content: [p]Edited the lighting settings of all cinematics to improve their visual and artistic quality Added a new bullet time to each hit based on its damage level.[/p]

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content: Reduced loading times and performance increased(+FPS) too has been introduced a fix for online mode to fix that caused people were not seeing names on room.

notes.title: Graphic Remasterization
notes.content: [p]All the next things were modified for gameplay stages:[/p][p][/p][p]Shaders modified[/p][p]Materials modified[/p][p]Textures Modified[/p][p]Lighting Changed[/p][p]Fog[/p][p]Advanced Lighting[/p][p]New Textures and shaders[/p][p]Advanced lighting for Vasaltis and enemies[/p]

notes.title: Stage Graphics changed, optimization
notes.content: [p]Stage Graphics changed, optimization[/p]

notes.title: Sky Improved and fixes
notes.content: [p]Fixed an issue that caused the character to get stuck when a specific combo was executed. All skies in the game have been improved.[/p]

notes.title: Attack Speed Selector DLC
notes.content: [p]The default attack speed is now the one that always was, the slow and the fast speed can be choosen now buying the new DLC. Sky improved.[/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: [p]The floor of the online mode has been improved. A fix has been introduced to address an issue in the online mode that caused players to attack themselves. Fixed a car suit issue.[/p]

notes.title: Slower Speed, Normal Health, Changed Camera
notes.content: [p]The speed is now slower to provide a more technical, paused and challenging gameplay. [/p][p]The health bar is not continuously decreased. [/p][p]The Default camera it´s now the pre-release default camera to provide a more inmersive experience.[/p]

notes.title: Online Fixes, Gamepad latency decreased
notes.content: [p]Fixed the black screen (disabling MSAA for online mode) and the issue of infinite loading of the next online room, and reduced gamepad latency.[/p]

notes.title: Super Speed, Fury Health, and Optimization
notes.content: [p]Super Speed:[/p][p]The Attack Speed has been increased a lot for History mode.[/p][p]Fury Health System:[/p][p]The health bar will decrease gradually because of being on the battlefield and consuming yourself, you will have to recover it defeating foes.[/p][p]Optimization:[/p][p]The enemy´s polygons has been reduced from 1.000 to 450, maintaining all the quality and details, reinforcing the enemy design and offering the double of performance for any enemy on screen.[/p][p]Fix:[/p][p]A fix has been included to prevent a problem on History mode.[/p][p]These new gameplay systems are now included and only present on history mode, the speed will continue being slow on online mode to provide the most technical experience there while the new gameplay system reinforces the gameplay for history mode, converting it in something much more technical and awesome than before.[/p]

notes.title: New far camera and Enemy Bars
notes.content: [p]-The new camera it´s the default now, you can change to a more near one pressing the camera zoom button. [/p][p]-The enemy bars are enabled now.[/p]

notes.title: Door Problem Fixed
notes.content: [p]Fixed an issue where you could not enter the door of any stage if you were playing offline, this issue arose from the online mode update, and has now been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: Story Mode Issue Fixed
notes.content: [p]Fixed an issue that caused the player to die when defeating any enemy in the Story Mode, this issue appeared in the latest updates to the Online Mode but has now been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: Matchmaking in middle of Gameplay
notes.content: [p]-You can now search for a game online while you are playing the story mode, and if you find an opponent then your exact position will be saved so that when you play again you will continue from that exact position. [/p][p]-Fixed all online glitches that caused some players to be unable to attack or be attacked by other players, as well as some other issues. [/p][p]-New online options have been added to the main menu.[/p]

notes.title: Online Mode X-Ray and Fixes
notes.content: [p]-The new button has been added to the online mode that you see through the walls. [/p][p]-A problem has been solved that caused 4 or more players, the impacts were not detected. [/p][p]-A problem has been solved that caused that when starting to attack at the beginning of the game the first attacks were not detected. [/p][p]-A problem has been solved that towards the scores were not seen correctly. [/p][p]-A problem has been solved that caused you to harm your rival just after it fell into the ground.[/p]

notes.title: Online Mode Fix 2
notes.content: [p]A problem that caused invencibility after respawn has been fixed.[/p][p]The Timeout has been decreased from 600 seconds to 300, the ending screen has been decreased from 60 seconds to 30.[/p]

notes.title: Online mode fixed
notes.content: [p]It has been solved: the problem that caused that attacks could not be detected the fragmentation of users by rooms now the next game is loaded once finished[/p]

notes.title: Online Mode PVP(Vanilla)
notes.content: [p]-Online Mode PVP created(only 1 map provisionally)(some bugs can appear because of the hard development made creating this mode)(less features than history mode because of combat system balancing, some others can be added via update)[/p][p]-Discord Link Fixed(recomended for find people to play online)[/p][p]-New Fanart[/p]

notes.title: Keyboard run key changes
notes.content: The run button of keyboard has been changed to W and now the autorun it´s the default, you can turn it off on options on the middle of gameplay.

notes.title: Sky Movement and -20% Run Speed
notes.content:
-Reduced running speed by 20% to provide better gameplay and immersion. 
-Now the sky moves, this gives a better atmosphere while you play.

notes.title: Changes and Corrections
notes.content:
-(Keyboard Controls) Now you will run only if you maintain pressed the key(you can change to auto-run mode changing this option on middle of gameplay on the pause screen menu)

-(First Stage) 2 Rocks of the first stage has been erased because it gave serious problems to very much players.

-(Triangle of K.O) A problem that caused to maintain all triangles of K.O after a new stage has been fixed.

-(Armors and Suit Selection Screen) Now it´s not any more randomized, only will be randomized if you choose the option to do it.

-(Online PVP Mode) This mode continues on development but will be available to play it very soon.

notes.content: Hidalgo Screen Removed

notes.title: Problem Fixed
notes.content: Fixed an issue that appeared in yesterday's update where you could not continue playing after a specific cutscene, now you can continue to advance normally.

notes.title: Fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where control type options were invisible in some languages such as Chinese.  
-The textures of all the characters have been more decompressed to improve their quality a little.  
-There is now a new option on the costume selection screen, this new option gives you the possibility to have all the costumes in the game for only $4.99 in addition to being able to randomize them.

notes.title: Dinamic Size Of Enemies
notes.content: The first stage of the game haves the same enemy size of allways but when you are advancing on history mode now the enemies will become more and more bigger.

notes.title: Graphical Improvement
notes.content: Graphical Improvement

notes.title: Day, Night and Classic Enemy
notes.content: -Now each stage has its dark version and its light version, these will change between one and the other as you advance in the story mode, sometimes it will be played during the day and sometimes at night.  -The classic enemy is back but with an optimization that offers twice the performance of the old version.  -New Fanart

notes.title: Fanarts New Game Mode
notes.content: In this new game mode you will be able to compete against the rest of the fanart drawings by creating and sending your own and you will also be able to see the rest of the drawings and their comments.

notes.title: Classic and New Controls
notes.content:
Now the players can choose between the default classic controls of the game or a new one control scheme where you can rotate the camera with the mouse and attack with the keyboard keys like very much players desired.

A control selection screen will show up allways before of enter the next stage asking if you want to attack with the keyboard keys or with the mouse, the one you choose will change the control scheme.

notes.title: Dark Atmosphere and much more improvements
notes.content:
-This new update offers the improvements of the previous reverted update with the draw distance not so aggressive and much more things. 

-Great Dark Atmosphere that affects The Entire Videogame to offer a better inmersion, it offers the graphic style and atmosphere that allways wanted the developer.

-This Update fixes completely fixed the "armor talking" problem for video cinematics.

-5 New Songs for the gameplay.

-The armor selection screen now doesn´t have enemies on screen.

-The Optimization and performance of enemies has been drasticaly improved, this fixes a performance problem that were suffering lot of people after avoid a lot of them, now the game supports much more enemies on screen, and unlimited if your are not seeing them, but all of them continues alive chasing the player if you avoid them, like the developer allways wanted.

notes.title: Bizarre Graphics and Better Performance
notes.content:
-The camera draw distance has been destroyed to have a better inmersion on the game and give a more challenging and artistic game experience.
-The soil of the first stage has been improved, this upgrade can be applied to the rest of stages on upcoming updates.
-Visual quality improved after erase the advanced light graphic option.
-Performance Highly improved.
-New text screen when you boot the videogame.

notes.title: Giant Enemies, Dinamic Soil, New Stage
notes.content:
-Enemies are now gigantic to offer a more spectacular and amazing gameplay experience. 
-The texture of the floor now changes dynamically each time it is played in order to offer a better and more varied artistic result.  
-Fixed an incorrect phrase in the endgame cinematic in the Spanish voice over.  
-A new additional Stage has been added just before watching the last video cinematic.  
-An enemy appears in the costume selection and chases Vasaltis, in order to offer a better artistic experience.

notes.title: Roll On and Enhanced Graphics
notes.content: In this latest update, rolling has been included in the game again, and the graphic quality has been improved.

notes.title: Rolling was erased
notes.content: The rolling has been removed of the game because breaks the game experience for some players.

notes.title: Fixed Controls
notes.content:
-Default Camera rotation it´s normal now. 
-Auto movement run it´s disabled by default now. 
-Added new tab when you pause the game in the middle of combat(Controls Tab) Here you can activate or deactivate the Auto movement run or select normal or inverted camera. 
-All the players who played this game before must select the new options pausing the game while in combat, and entering the controls tab, here you can select the new options, or choose the old ones, the new players will have the default options enabled by default, the old ones haves to change it.

notes.title: Achievements Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where 2 achievements could not be obtained, now it has been fixed and can now be obtained.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed a problem that caused 3 stages to repeat themselves at the final part of the game, They have now been replaced by new ones and are no longer repeated.

 -One screen of text has been fixed, and now can be readed and understanded better in any language

notes.title: Door Fixed
notes.content: The closed door of the newly developed stage for the release has been fixed, and now it opens correctly.

notes.title: Bug Fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused some stages to have no enemies.

notes.title: Live Stream During Next Fest
notes.content: Randomly the developer will play the demo during Steam Next Fest.

notes.title: Visual Quality Improvement
notes.content: The lighting settings, sky, and textures has been improved, now it haves more sharpness and better colors.

notes.title: 5 more Stage ambientations added
notes.content: 5 new textures have been added for all the scenarios in the game, now there are 13 for each stage and 55 skies, before there were only 8 and 55, The possible randomly combined settings for each time you play are now totally unpredictable, there are more than 700 possible combinations.

notes.title: Gameplay and Graphics Improvements
notes.content: Lighting has been adjusted for better visual quality, loading times have been reduced, textures have been improved, fixes have been applied, keys have been changed to the following: (W A S D F G H C V), now you can roll in the middle of a combo or right after having performed an attack in order to improve the gameplay and make it more dynamic and spectacular,  The Strong Fury attack can now be used if you press both mouse buttons at the same time and have at least 50% red bar.

notes.title: Graphical Enhancement and Fixes
notes.content: The previous graphics system has been changed and the dynamic scenario setting has been activated (every time you play the textures change and so does the sky) The lighting and texturing graphic settings have been improved, some things in the game have been corrected, the difficulty has been adjusted, the enemy speed has been reduced on Normal difficulty. It is recommended to enable MSAA x8 for all players who have played the demo prior to this announcement in order to have the best visual quality and immersion.

notes.title: Graphics Quality and Lighting Changes/Fixes
notes.content: Removed Strong Colors and Bad Textures, performance optimization improved, new update available now.

notes.title: Graphical Upgrade
notes.content:
It includes new graphics, textures, normal maps and lighting system settings, everything has been fine-tuned to get the highest grapghical experience and performance at the same time, now the Stages image capsules have been changed to the updated version and the demo was released yesterday with this new graphics system, It's a giant wash out for the game.

All changes are also available for the full game, which will be available on March 5.
